[[File:UCB_Miscellaneous_Mathematical_Symbols-B.png | thumb | right | Graphical representation of the Miscellaneous Mathematical Symbols-B Unicode block]]
'''Miscellaneous Mathematical Symbols-B''' is a [[Unicode block]] containing miscellaneous mathematical symbols, including brackets, angles, and circle symbols.

==Block==
{{Unicode chart Miscellaneous Mathematical Symbols-B}}

==Variant==
The Miscellaneous Mathematical Symbols-B block has one variation sequence defined for a [[Variant form (Unicode)|standardized variant]].
Variation selector-1 (VS1) (U+FE00) can be used with {{unichar|29B7}} to request a [[glyph]] where the parallel lines touch the circle.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unicode.org/Public/UCD/latest/ucd/StandardizedVariants.txt|title=Unicode Character Database: Standardized Variation Sequences | publisher=The Unicode Consortium}}</ref>

==Usage==
Some of these symbols are used in [[Z notation]]. Specifically 
*{{unichar|2981|Z NOTATION SPOT}}
*{{unichar|2982|Z NOTATION TYPE COLON}}
*{{unichar|2987|Z NOTATION LEFT IMAGE BRACKET}}
*{{unichar|2988|Z NOTATION RIGHT IMAGE BRACKET}}
*{{unichar|2989|Z NOTATION LEFT BINDING BRACKET}}
*{{unichar|298A|Z NOTATION RIGHT BINDING BRACKET}}
The last two symbols are used in [[Tiny and miny|combinatorial game theory]] 
*{{unichar|29FE|TINY}}
*{{unichar|29FF|MINY}}
